description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery component, focusing on discovering serve gateways using Tailscale peers, handling unavailable status, resolving executable paths, and ensuring correct environment variable setup for subprocesses.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayDiscoveryTests
classes.description: A test suite for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, implementing various test cases to ensure reliable behavior.

methods.name: discovers serve gateway from tailnet peers
methods.description: Tests the discovery of a serve gateway from tailnet peer data using mocked JSON status and probe logic.

methods.name: returns empty when status unavailable
methods.description: Ensures the discovery process returns an empty list when the Tailscale status data is unavailable.

methods.name: resolves bare executable from PATH
methods.description: Verifies that the path resolution method correctly finds an executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: rejects missing executable candidate
methods.description: Checks that the path resolution correctly handles missing executables.

methods.name: adds TERM for GUI-launched tailscale subprocesses
methods.description: Ensures that the environment for subprocesses includes the TERM variable set to 'dumb' if not already specified.

methods.name: preserves existing TERM when building tailscale subprocess environment
methods.description: Verifies that an existing TERM environment variable is preserved when creating the subprocess environment.
